items.title: Bird flu could be catastrophic for nation's vulnerable species, experts warn
items.description: The black swan, the Tasmanian devil and Australian sea lions are among the species at risk if a deadly strain of avian influenza takes hold in Australia, experts are warning.

items.title: Why this Paraguay star was red-carded for covering his mouth
items.description: Paraguay's Miguel Almirón fell victim to new laws put in place at this World Cup to counter discriminatory behaviour. So what are the new laws in place?

items.title: Live: Panthers start hot against Titans despite missing Origin stars
items.description: After months of speculation and years of close calls, North Queensland re-signs coach Todd Payten. Meanwhile, the Titans host a Panthers side missing their Origin stars. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Hawk handed AFL ban after high shot that broke opponent's jaw
items.description: Adelaide coach Matthew Nicks has said the Crows football club will be there for former player Tony Modra after the great's truck crash earlier this week. Follow live.

items.title: Steve Irwin 'wouldn't have wanted this': Australia Zoo calls police on traditional owner
items.description: Traditional owner Alwyn Lyall says he felt "extremely upset and humiliated" when police asked him to leave Australia Zoo, where he was trying to see a crocodile he says was "wrongfully arrested" and taken from the wild.

items.title: Could the 'bliss' trade set millions up for a comfortable retirement?
items.description: Does "bliss" — big lasting state support for financial entities deemed too big to fail — make the stock market a one-way bet?

items.title: Melbourne woman suffers acute liver failure after using knock-off drug
items.description: Megan Hancocks bought a drug labelled as the peptide compound retatrutide in cash from a beautician. Within a week of her second dose, she was in acute liver failure.

items.title: A diabolical Iran deal reveals the Trump administration's delusions
items.description: Just as Netanyahu's claims to be able to influence Trump have now become a burden to him, Trump's limited capacity to influence Netanyahu spells just as much trouble for peace in the Middle East.

items.title: Twin brothers born deaf hear their mum's voice for first time after epic surgery
items.description: An Australian-first eight hour surgical feat had one main purpose — for Artie and Jack to hear their mum's voice at the same time.

items.title: 'Everything's just so wrong': Inside the country town that turned to One Nation
items.description: In just a few short weeks, a small country town became One Nation heartland. It is a blueprint for how the party can turn Australia orange.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
